input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: quality census (mode draw: census), six never-audited subjects
errors: Two audit files (house-market, loopclosure-twin) were committed while their auditors were still writing, because a stop hook asked for untracked files to be committed; the final versions were committed afterwards, so the end state is correct.

My first CSV guard in construction-evidence-log defused plain negative numbers too; run_workflow_locally (test_check_csv_formula_guard) caught it; fixed with the anchored number exemption and removed the file from csv_formula_guard_baseline.txt.

doc_friction.issue: mark-fixed is per defect; one defect that bundles several surviving mutants (mimic-cursor defect 0) cannot record a partial fix, so a fix that closes one of five mutants is left unmarked, and the PR is missing from that audit's fix_prs.
Fires while background auditors are still writing their files into the tree, which pushes half-written audit files. Auditors writing to the scratchpad first and copying at the end would avoid this.

deviations.why: Step 4 says to fix small defects 'in its own commit'. I did that, but the fixes went into the same PR as the audits rather than separate PRs. The README allows this (fix_prs lists the round PR).
deviations.did: Fix commits are separate in the round PR #17841
deviations.result: Audits and their fixes land together; fixed_by points at #17841

notes: Mode: census (seeded draw). Seed 2026-11-20-be43. Subjects: ventures/saas-seat-true-up, research/mimic-cursor, research/loopclosure-twin, ventures/construction-evidence-log, research/house-market, ventures/ai-engineering-academy. Share meeting the bar: 0 of 6 (census, not counted in the sampled share, which stays 36/367, Wilson 7-13%); finished 6/6. Seeded mutations caught 12/32; checks failed or partial 35/79; defects 45 (1 high). Fix PR: #17841 (saas tile label + 14-day boundary test; construction-evidence-log day count + CSV formula neutralisation; house-market headline pin test + two README figures; loopclosure-twin published-row pin test; mimic-cursor copy-cap test (partial, unmarked); ai-engineering-academy divider significant figures + µA display). Spot-checks I ran myself: seat arithmetic, Denver row in results.txt, 38.7% from facts.csv, loopclosure dof and c*c mutants now caught, mimic copy-cap mutant now caught. Local verification: node --test for the three ventures (69, 29, 27 pass), unittest/pytest for the three research projects (12, 10, 10 pass), check_posts ok, check_md_links ok, quality_audit validate 0 problems; run_workflow_locally --for-changes: 16/17 workflows passed first time; ventures-tests failed on test_check_csv_formula_guard (my guard lacked a number exemption), fixed and rerun green.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: six first audits at ~2 h each with recomputation and mutation, plus six small fixes with tests

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
